model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигура 6 се състои от десет графики, организирани в пет реда по две колони. Лявата колона показва графики, озаглавени с варианти на „Massive Activation of…", а дясната колона — с варианти на „first token attention scores of…". Всеки ред съответства на различна конфигурация: baseline (ред 1), atten_output_gate (ред 2), v_elementwise (ред 3), atten_output_gate_head_share (ред 4) и atten_output_gate_wo_sparsity (ред 5). Всички графики споделят обща ос X, обозначена като „Layer", с линейна скала от 0 до приблизително 22–23, с етикети през интервали от 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20).

В лявата колона оста Y е обозначена като „Max Activation Value". В графиката на ред 1 (baseline) диапазонът на оста Y е от 0 до 1600, с етикети през 200 или 400. Представени са четири линии: „attn_output" (синя пунктирана), „attn_residual" (оранжева плътна), „ffn_output" (зелена пунктирана) и „ffn_residual" (червена плътна). Всички линии остават близо до нула от слой 0 до приблизително слой 6, след което рязко нарастват. Зелената пунктирана линия (ffn_output) достига стойности около 1200–1400 в района на слоеве 7–10, след което показва колебания с видим спад около слой 12 и повторно нарастване. Червената линия (ffn_residual) следва подобна тенденция, но с по-високи стойности, достигащи около 1400–1500. Синята пунктирана линия (attn_output) също нараства, но остава по-ниска, около 400–800. Оранжевата линия (attn_residual) се движи близо до червената.

В графиката на ред 2 (atten_output_gate) оста Y е от 0 до 400, с етикети през 50. Четирите линии следват сходна цветова и стилова схема. Всички линии остават близо до нула от слой 0 до около слой 5–6, след което постепенно нарастват. Стойностите остават значително по-ниски в сравнение с baseline, като максималните стойности достигат около 350–400 при последните слоеве. Зелената и червената линии са най-високи, а синята и оранжевата — по-ниски.

В графиката на ред 3 (v_elementwise) оста Y е от 0 до 350, с етикети през 50. Линиите отново остават близо до нула до около слой 5, след което нарастват. Максималните стойности достигат около 300–350 при последните слоеве, с видими колебания.

В графиката на ред 4 (atten_output_gate_head_share) оста Y е от 0 до 500. Линиите показват нарастване след слой 5–6, достигайки стойности около 400–500 при последните слоеве, с колебания в средните и късните слоеве.

В графиката на ред 5 (atten_output_gate_wo_sparsity) оста Y е от 0 до 1400–1600. Линиите показват рязко нарастване след слой 5–6, подобно на baseline, достигайки стойности около 1200–1400, с изразени колебания и пикове.

В дясната колона оста Y е обозначена като „first token attention score" с диапазон от 0.0 до 1.0, с етикети през 0.2. Всяка графика съдържа две линии: „first token attention score" (синя плътна) и „mean" (зелена пунктирана хоризонтална линия).

В графиката на ред 1 (baseline) средната стойност е обозначена като 0.467. Синята линия започва от стойност около 0.2 при слой 0, нараства рязко до около 0.8–1.0 при слоеве 6–8, след което показва значителни колебания между 0.4 и 1.0, с видими спадове около слоеве 12 и 18 и пикове около слоеве 8, 14 и 20.

В графиката на ред 2 (atten_output_gate) средната стойност е 0.049. Синята линия остава много близо до нула през целия диапазон на слоевете, с минимални колебания, без видими пикове.

В графиката на ред 3 (v_elementwise) средната стойност е 0.297. Синята линия започва около 0.2, нараства до около 0.5–0.6 при слоеве 6–8, след което колебае между 0.2 и 0.6 с видими спадове и пикове.

В графиката на ред 4 (atten_output_gate_head_share) средната стойност е 0.301. Синята линия започва около 0.2, нараства до около 0.6–0.8 при слоеве 6–8, след което показва колебания между 0.2 и 0.8, с видим спад около слой 12.

В графиката на ред 5 (atten_output_gate_wo_sparsity) средната стойност е 0.461. Синята линия започва около 0.2, нараства рязко до около 0.8–1.0 при слоеве 6–8, след което колебае между 0.4 и 1.0, с видими пикове и спадове, подобни на тези в графиката на baseline.
model_annotations.Chinese:
This figure presents a comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations, organized in five rows of paired plots. Each row corresponds to a different configuration: baseline, atten_output_gate, v_elementwise, atten_output_gate_head_share, and atten_output_gate_wo_sparsity. The left column of plots shares a common x-axis labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick intervals of 5, and a common y-axis labeled "Max Activation Value." The right column of plots shares a common x-axis labeled "layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick intervals of 5, and a common y-axis labeled "first token attention score" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.2.

In the first row (baseline), the left plot has a y-axis ranging from 0 to approximately 1600. Four lines are shown: a blue dashed line labeled "attn_output," an orange dashed line labeled "attn_residual," a green dashed line labeled "ffn_output," and a red solid line labeled "ffn_residual." All four lines remain near 0 from layer 0 to approximately layer 6. After layer 6, the green line (ffn_output) rises sharply to around 1200 and fluctuates between approximately 1000 and 1500 through the remaining layers. The red line (ffn_residual) follows a similar sharp increase after layer 6, reaching values around 1200–1400. The blue line (attn_output) rises modestly after layer 6 to values around 200–400. The orange line (attn_residual) rises to values roughly tracking the red line. In the right plot, a blue solid line labeled "first token attention score" starts near 0.4 at layer 0, rises sharply around layer 5–6 to approximately 0.9–1.0, and remains elevated with fluctuations through the remaining layers, dipping notably around layer 18 before recovering. A green dashed line labeled "mean: 0.467" is shown as a horizontal reference.

In the second row (atten_output_gate), the left plot has a y-axis ranging from 0 to approximately 400. The four lines (same color and style coding) all remain relatively low throughout, with values generally below 50 across all layers, though there are minor fluctuations. The green and red lines show slight increases in later layers reaching approximately 50–100. In the right plot, the blue solid line for first token attention score remains very low, fluctuating near 0.0 to 0.1 across all layers. The green dashed horizontal line indicates a mean of 0.049.

In the third row (v_elementwise), the left plot has a y-axis ranging from 0 to approximately 350. The four lines remain near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 5, then show modest increases. The green and red lines rise to approximately 50–100 in later layers, with occasional spikes. The blue and orange lines remain relatively low. In the right plot, the blue solid line starts around 0.3 at layer 0, fluctuates between approximately 0.2 and 0.6 across layers, with a notable peak around layer 7 reaching approximately 0.55. The green dashed horizontal line indicates a mean of 0.297.

In the fourth row (atten_output_gate_head_share), the left plot has a y-axis ranging from 0 to approximately 500. The lines remain near 0 until approximately layer 5–6, after which the green and red lines rise to values around 200–400, with notable spikes around layers 10 and 20. The blue and orange lines show more moderate increases. In the right plot, the blue solid line starts near 0.2, rises around layer 5–6 to approximately 0.6–0.8, and fluctuates in that range with a dip around layer 18. The green dashed horizontal line indicates a mean of 0.391.

In the fifth row (atten_output_gate_wo_sparsity), the left plot has a y-axis ranging from 0 to approximately 1600. The pattern closely resembles the baseline: all lines remain near 0 until approximately layer 6, after which the green and red lines rise sharply to approximately 1000–1400, with fluctuations through the remaining layers. The blue and orange lines show moderate increases. In the right plot, the blue solid line starts near 0.3 at layer 0, rises sharply around layer 5–6 to approximately 0.8–1.0, and remains elevated with fluctuations, including a dip around layer 18. The green dashed horizontal line indicates a mean of 0.461.
model_annotations.English:
This figure presents a comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across five different gating configurations, arranged in five rows with two plots per row (left: massive activations, right: first token attention scores).

All left-column plots share the same axis structure: the x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" with a linear scale, though the range varies across rows. Each left plot contains four lines representing attn_output (blue, dashed), attn_residual (orange, solid), ffn_output (green, dashed), and ffn_residual (red, solid). All right-column plots share the same axis structure: the x-axis is labeled "layer" with a linear scale from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5, and the y-axis is labeled "first token attention score" with a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0. Each right plot contains a blue solid line for the first token attention score and a green dashed horizontal line indicating the mean value.

In the first row (baseline), the left plot has a y-axis range of 0 to approximately 1600. All four lines remain near zero from layer 0 to about layer 6, after which they rise sharply. The green dashed line (ffn_output) and red solid line (ffn_residual) reach values around 1200–1500 by layer 10 and remain elevated with fluctuations through layer 22. The blue dashed and orange solid lines also rise but remain somewhat lower. The right plot shows the first token attention score near 0.0–0.2 for layers 0 through approximately 5, then jumping sharply to around 0.8–1.0 at layer 6, remaining elevated with fluctuations through layer 22. The mean is indicated as 0.467.

In the second row (atten_output_gate), the left plot has a y-axis range of 0 to approximately 400. All four lines remain near zero or at low values (below 50) across all layers, with some minor fluctuations. The right plot shows the first token attention score remaining low, generally below 0.1 across all layers, with the mean indicated as 0.049.

In the third row (v_elementwise), the left plot has a y-axis range of 0 to approximately 350. The lines remain near zero from layer 0 to about layer 6, then the green and red lines rise to approximately 50–100 and remain at moderate levels with some fluctuations. The blue and orange lines show similar but slightly lower patterns. The right plot shows the first token attention score fluctuating between approximately 0.2 and 0.5 across layers, with some peaks around layers 5–8 reaching approximately 0.5–0.6. The mean is indicated as 0.297.

In the fourth row (atten_output_gate_head_share), the left plot has a y-axis range of 0 to approximately 500. The lines remain near zero until about layer 5, then rise with the green and red lines reaching approximately 300–500 by layers 15–20, with notable fluctuations. The right plot shows the first token attention score remaining relatively low (around 0.2–0.4) for early layers, then rising to approximately 0.6–0.9 for layers beyond about layer 8, with fluctuations. The mean is indicated as 0.391.

In the fifth row (atten_output_gate_wo_sparsity), the left plot has a y-axis range of 0 to approximately 1600. The lines remain near zero until about layer 5–6, then rise sharply with the green and red lines reaching values around 1000–1400 by layer 10, remaining elevated with substantial fluctuations through layer 22. The right plot shows the first token attention score near 0.0–0.2 for layers 0 through about 5, then jumping to approximately 0.6–1.0 at layer 6 and remaining elevated with fluctuations. The mean is indicated as 0.461.
